_doc: Newblades enchant tuning (tracker #415). NOT retail data: enchanting.json holds the APK's tables, this file overrides them. Every key defaults to today's behaviour when absent, and a missing or invalid file is the default. Read at startup: edit, then `deploy/arena.sh static` (restarts the arena).
_secondaryCountOdds: Owner decision d22. P(0), P(1), P(2) secondary enchantments for a NON-arcane item, per item type; first matching rule wins, and a table no rule matches keeps its retail odds. itemType: 2 weapon, 3 armor, 9 shield, 10 ring, 11 necklace. equipmentSlot (armor): 1 head, 3 body, 4 hands, 7 feet. weaponType: absent = every weapon. The values below ARE retail (SecondaryEnchantmentEffectData in the APK); arcane tiers 1 and 2 keep their fixed one / two regardless.
_doubleRavagePity: Owner decision d17, not retail. After `tries[class]` weapon enchants in a row without both Ravage Magicka and Ravage Stamina, the next one in that class gets both. class: normal = no arcane tier, arcane2 = arcane tier 2 (arcane 1 rolls one secondary, so it has no timer). Thresholds = expected tries 1 / (P(two secondaries) x 2 x 0.07 x 0.07 / 0.93): 632.7 normal, 94.9 arcane2. A class absent or set to 0 is never forced. enabled: false turns the timer off.
